v: The elder, To the beloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth:
The elder, to the beloved Gaius, whom I love in truth.
{From John} the Church Leader. To Gaius, my dear friend, whom I truly love.
Beloved, I pray that in every way you may prosper and enjoy good health, as your soul also prospers.
Beloved, I pray concerning everything {for} you to prosper and to be healthy, just as your soul prospers.
Dear friend, I am asking God to make everything go well for you and to keep you healthy physically, just as you are healthy in respect to God.
For I was overjoyed when the brothers came and testified about your devotion to the truth, in which you continue to walk.
For I rejoiced greatly when brothers came and attested to your truth, just as you are walking in truth.

I know that you are healthy in respect to God because some fellow believers came here and told me about your truthful way of living. They said that you live according to the true message about Jesus. That makes me very happy.
I know that you are healthy in respect to God because
I have no greater joy than to hear that my children are walking in the truth.
I have no greater joy than these things, that I hear my children are walking in the truth. \*
This is what makes me the very happiest—when someone tells me that the people whom I have helped to follow Jesus are living according to the true message from God! \*
Beloved, you are faithful in what you are doing for the brothers, and especially since they are strangers to you.
Beloved, you are doing a faithful thing whenever you might work for the brothers, and this {for} strangers,
Dear friend, you are serving Jesus loyally whenever you do things to help fellow believers, even those whom you do not know.
those whom you do not know
those whom you do not know
They have testified to the church about your love. You will do well to send them on their way in a manner worthy of God.
who have attested your love before the church, whom you will do well to send on worthily of God,

Some of them have reported before the congregation {here} how you have shown that you love them. Such people are traveling in order to be obedient to Jesus and they have decided to allow only fellow believers to help them as they travel. Therefore it is good that you give such people what they need for traveling in a {generous} way that honors God.
to send them on their way
have shown that you love them
For they went out on behalf of the Name, accepting nothing from the Gentiles.
for they went out for the sake of the name, receiving nothing from the Gentiles.
Therefore we ought to support such men, so that we may be fellow workers for the truth.
Therefore we ourselves ought to support such ones so that we may become fellow workers with the truth. \*
In fact, all of us {who believe in Jesus} should give these people whatever they need. Then it will be as though we are working alongside them as they help others to know God’s true message. \*
as they help others to know God s true message
as they help others to know God s true message
I have written to the church about this, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first, will not accept our instruction.
I wrote something to the church, but Diotrephes, the one loving to be first among them, does not receive us.
I wrote a letter to your group of believers to tell them to help those other believers. However, Diotrephes, who wants to dominate your group, refuses to do this.
to your group of believers to tell them to help those other believers
to your group of believers to tell them to help those other believers

So if I come, I will call attention to his malicious slander against us. And unsatisfied with that, he refuses to welcome the brothers and forbids those who want to do so, even putting them out of the church.

Because of this, if I come, I will call attention to his works that he is doing—accusing us with evil words. And not being satisfied with these things, he does not receive the brothers, and he stops the ones willing and puts them out of the church. \*

So when I arrive there I will publicly tell everyone what he does: He says bad things about us that are not true. In addition to doing that, he also refuses to welcome the believers {who are traveling in order to do God’s work}. He even prevents those who do want to welcome them and forces them to leave the group of believers! \*
Beloved, do not imitate what is evil, but what is good. The one who does good is of God; the one who does evil has not seen God.
Beloved, do not imitate the evil, but the good. The one doing good is from God; the one doing evil has not seen God.

Dear friend, do not copy a bad example {like that}. Instead, do the good things that you see good people doing. {Remember that} people who do good deeds truly belong to God. But anyone who keeps doing what is bad does not know God.
do the good things that you see good people doing
do the good things that you see good people doing
Remember that people who do good deeds
Remember that people who do good deeds
Demetrius has received a good testimony from everyone, and from the truth itself. We also testify for him, and you know that our testimony is true.
Demetrius has been attested to by all and by the truth itself. And we ourselves also attest, and you know that our testimony is true. \*

People widely praise Demetrius as a good person. The way that he lives according to God’s true message also makes it clear that he is a good person. We also confirm that he is a good person, and you know that what we say is true. \*
The way that he lives according to God s true message
The way that he lives according to God s true message
The way that he lives according to God s true message
The way that he lives according to God s true message
I have many things to write to you, but I would prefer not to do so with pen and ink.
I have many things to write to you, but I do not wish to write them to you with ink and pen.
There are many {more} things about which I could write to you. But I do not want to write to you {about them} in a letter.
Instead, I hope to see you soon and speak with you face to face. Peace to you. The friends here send you greetings. Greet each of our friends there by name.
But I expect to see you soon, and we will speak mouth to mouth.
Instead, I hope to come and see you soon. Then we will talk directly with one another.
